sloka: सर्वे पर्वतसङ्काशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः ।सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधाश्चास्य महौजसः ।। ६.५९.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: sarve parvatasaṅkāśāḥ sarve parvatayodhinaḥ ।sarve dīptāyudhadharā yodhāścāsya mahaujasaḥ ।। 6.59.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."
